prepared.body: Your chef gets the ingredients. You have time for yourselves and the children.

cooked.title: Cooked for you.
cooked.body: Three courses, freshly prepared in the loft and served at your table.

clean.title: Left clean.
clean.body: Your chef cleans up the kitchen. You let the evening wind down.

included.question: What is included in the service?
included.answer: Personal menu coordination, grocery shopping, fresh on-site cooking, serving three courses, and a clean kitchen afterward.

after.question: What happens after the request?
after.answer: We check availability and align the menu with you. You then get the final booking confirmation once chef and date are confirmed.

wishes.question: Allergies, children, and special wishes
wishes.answer: In the next step you share your wishes and allergies. We clarify allergies with the chef again before confirmation. Children portions are usually priced lower.

cost.question: What does your dinner cost?
cost.answer: Shown amounts are example prices starting from the Signature menu. Your chef sets the final offer. No payment is taken with the request.
